$comment: MONARK vocabulary gate — ADR-M001 D8 / ADR-M002 D0 (09 discipline, Grok, adopted). Single source read by scripts/grep-forbidden.mjs and by any package test (atelier_no_forbidden_vocab). Regex source strings, flags 'i'. Adding a pattern = ADR line. 'banned' = GLOBAL patterns (all scanned files). A scan.<x>.banned block = patterns SCOPED to that walk only (e.g. naked Hermes, bounded to packages/monark/** by ADR-M003 D12 — not global because packages/contracts/src is FROZEN and carries a non-editable 'Hermes').

banned.why: "X % of ... correct/winning" claim (any X) — ADR-M002 D1 Lot D item (1)
naked "Hermes" forbidden in packages/monark/** — name collision (Pyth Hermes vs ClawPump harness); qualify as pyth-hermes / clawpump-hermes (ADR-M003 D12, pre-verif 4)

site.$comment_exempt: exemptPhrases: closed list (PLAN F-2 §12 errata, Lot F-2b). Honest fleet-invariant copy may keep an otherwise-banned word here the negation 'no confidence field' from the README; those exact spans are masked before matching, scope 'site' only, so 'high confidence' still reddens. Load-bearing and non-inert proof in test/ci-gates.test.ts.

banned.why: "autonomous" — no autonomy claim on the public storefront (README v2 proscribed vocab; PLAN F-2 C6)
"predicts" — the fleet conforms a predictor, it does not itself predict (C6)
"confidence" — no confidence field/score anywhere (fleet invariant; C6)
"hedge fund" — MONARK is not a fund (C6)
"Kraidle" — internal name, never on the public storefront (C6)
